# VectorBinary2Ascii

Module: **core** · directory: `src/Programs` · binary: `src/Programs/VectorBinary2Ascii`

Manual: [VectorBinary2Ascii (from the DiagHam wiki)](../manuals/VectorBinary2Ascii.md)

```text
VectorBinary2Ascii, version 0.01

Usage: VectorBinary2Ascii [options] 

Options:

system options:
    -i, --input-vector : name of the file containing the binary vector
    -o, --output-vector : name of the file where the vector will be stored in ASCII mode
    --add-index : write ascii vector in a two-column formatted output (first column for the component index, second for the component value)
    --min-range : display vector starting from a given component (is negative, start couting from the last component) from  (default value = 0)
    --max-range : display vector up to a given component (0 if up to the end) (default value = 0)
    -s, --std-output : use standard output instead of an output file
    -c, --complex : indicate that the input vector has complex coefficients
    -r, --rational : indicate that the input vector has rational coefficients
    --use-longlong : use 128bit(64bits) integers instead of 64bits(32bits) integers in rational mode
    --two-columns : output complex or rational vectors as a two column formatted text file
    --hide-component : hide state components (and thus the corresponding n-body state) whose absolute value is lower than a given error (0 if all components have to be shown (default value = 0)

misc options:
    -h, --help : display this help

global options:
    --append-cmdline : append command line to file
```
